theory.title: Although, even though, despite e in spite of
theory.explanation: Usa although y even though seguidos de una oración con sujeto y verbo. Usa despite e in spite of seguidos de un sustantivo o de un verbo en -ing. Todas estas expresiones introducen un contraste: Although it was raining (aunque llovía) / Despite the rain (a pesar de la lluvia).
theory.tip: Although + frase completa; despite/in spite of + sustantivo o -ing.

patterns.label: Although, even though, despite e in spite of · 1
patterns.pattern: Although the journey was long, we enjoyed it.
examples:
Although the journey was long, we enjoyed it.
→ Aunque el viaje fue largo, lo disfrutamos.

patterns.label: Although, even though, despite e in spite of · 2
patterns.pattern: Even though she was tired, she joined the event.
examples:
Even though she was tired, she joined the event.
→ Aunque estaba cansada, participó en el evento.

patterns.label: Although, even though, despite e in spite of · 3
patterns.pattern: Despite the language barrier, we understood each other.
examples:
Despite the language barrier, we understood each other.
→ A pesar de la barrera lingüística, nos entendimos.

patterns.label: Although, even though, despite e in spite of · 4
patterns.pattern: In spite of feeling nervous, he gave a speech.
examples:
In spite of feeling nervous, he gave a speech.
→ A pesar de sentirse nervioso, dio un discurso.

patterns.label: Although, even though, despite e in spite of · 5
patterns.pattern: Although the town was small, it welcomed many visitors.
examples:
Although the town was small, it welcomed many visitors.
→ Aunque el pueblo era pequeño, recibió a muchos visitantes.

patterns.label: Although, even though, despite e in spite of · 6
patterns.pattern: Despite the rain, the festival continued.
examples:
Despite the rain, the festival continued.
→ A pesar de la lluvia, el festival continuó.

patterns.label: Although, even though, despite e in spite of · 7
patterns.pattern: Even though they disagreed, they listened politely.
examples:
Even though they disagreed, they listened politely.
→ Aunque no estaban de acuerdo, escucharon con educación.

patterns.label: Although, even though, despite e in spite of · 8
patterns.pattern: In spite of the cost, the trip was worthwhile.
examples:
In spite of the cost, the trip was worthwhile.
→ A pesar del coste, el viaje mereció la pena.

patterns.label: Although, even though, despite e in spite of · 9
patterns.pattern: Although I had little time, I visited the museum.

Although I had little time, I visited the museum.
→ Aunque tenía poco tiempo, visité el museo.

patterns.label: Although, even though, despite e in spite of · 10
patterns.pattern: Despite having different backgrounds, they became friends.
examples:
Despite having different backgrounds, they became friends.
→ A pesar de tener orígenes distintos, se hicieron amigos.

Even though some guests did not speak the local language, volunteers helped everyone understand the programme. In spite of the difficulties, the organisers were pleased with the result. They believe that people can build strong connections despite having different backgrounds.

items.prompt: Describe an event you enjoyed although the weather was bad.
items.modelAnswer: I believe learning about other cultures helps people become more open-minded. When I visit a new place, I try to respect local customs and learn a few useful expressions. At first, some differences may feel unfamiliar, but people can understand one another if they communicate politely. I enjoy meeting local people because we can share experiences and learn from each other. In the future, I hope to take part in more international exchanges.

content.audioTranscript: A: How was the cultural exchange? B: Great. The students stayed with a local host family. A: Did they learn about local traditions? B: Yes, and they practised the language every day. A: Did they attend the town festival? B: They did. The whole community was involved. A: How did the visitors behave? B: They showed respect and made new friendships.
